content:
tvOS 27 is the latest software update for Apple TV 4K, and it's now rolling out to all users. Here's an overview of the new features in tvOS 27.

tvOS 27 brings a refreshed Apple Podcasts app, new Apple Music features, customizable text size, and more changes.

tvOS 27 can now be installed via the Settings app on Apple TV. This update supports all Apple TV 4K models except the first generation; Apple TV HD is not supported.

Apple's tvOS 27 update includes the following features and changes:

Podcasts: The Apple Podcasts app on tvOS has received a major redesign, similar to the earlier iOS update this year. The new tvOS Podcasts app fully supports Apple's new video features, making it a great choice for watching video podcasts. The interface also features a brand-new design with elements like sidebar navigation.

Updating via iPhone: A thoughtful change in tvOS 27 is that users can now update their Apple TV 4K directly from their iPhone. Through the iOS 27 Home app, you can install tvOS 27 and future updates without having to turn on your Apple TV.

Apple Music upgrades: tvOS 27 brings two new features to Apple Music. AutoMix lands on Apple TV, offering DJ-style transitions between songs—perfect for parties. The other is Hi-Res Lossless Audio, available for users with compatible external speaker output.

Larger text size: You can now use the Dynamic Type feature in the Settings app to customize the system-wide text size, making it easier to enlarge text based on your needs and viewing environment.

Finally, Apple says tvOS 27 supports faster AirPlay connections, smoother animations and app launch speeds, and makes Control Center more responsive.

What's missing: Siri AI and smart downloads

A notable absence in tvOS 27 is the new Siri AI assistant—only the old Siri is available. According to rumors, this is because a new Apple TV 4K is on the way, equipped with hardware upgrades capable of running Siri AI.

Another missing update is the "Smart Downloads" feature Apple mentioned at WWDC. tvOS has never supported downloading TV content, so the announcement came as a surprise. "Smart Downloads" might refer to some system-related feature rather than TV shows and movies. Either way, the feature is nowhere to be found in the tvOS 27 beta.

Have you installed tvOS 27 yet? How does it feel to use? Share your thoughts in the comments.
